skill.name: softsync-shared-inbox
skill.description: Manage shared team mailboxes by finding waiting conversations, assigning tasks, reading threads, replying with confirmation, and closing completed work.
skill.summary: Turn shared mailbox conversations into clear, assigned, and trackable team work.
skill.author: softsync-lab

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when customer conversations lack ownership, context, or a clear completion state. This skill connects mailbox conversations with tasks so teams can triage, assign, reply, and close work consistently.
actual_capabilities: List shared mailboxes with unread, waiting, and assigned-work counts.
Find unassigned or personally assigned customer conversations.
Read complete email threads for a selected mailbox and time window.
Assign tasks, mark work completed, or reopen tasks.
Create a task for an older conversation that has no task.
Draft and send a confirmed reply in the existing conversation thread.
limitations: It requires mailbox access to read messages and group membership to view tasks.
It does not create tasks automatically; the mailbox automation must already be configured.
It cannot recall a reply after the shared mailbox sends it.
Bulk assignment or closure requires explicit confirmation.

use_cases.title: Triage customer support
use_cases.description: Find waiting and unassigned customer conversations, review their context, and route each task to the appropriate teammate.

use_cases.title: Work a personal queue
use_cases.description: Review conversations assigned to you, read the full thread, reply from the shared mailbox, and close completed tasks.

use_cases.title: Recover older conversations
use_cases.description: Locate messages created before automation, verify that no task exists, and create an owned or unassigned task for follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: See the inbox status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the shared inboxes I can work, including unread, waiting, and assigned conversation counts.

prompt_templates.title: Find unassigned work
prompt_templates.prompt: Find open customer conversations in the support mailbox that have no owner, then summarize the subject and ticket number.

prompt_templates.title: Work my queue
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my open support tasks from this week, read the full thread for the highest priority item, and suggest a concise reply.

prompt_templates.title: Handle an older thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Find older support conversations without tasks, verify each conversation has no existing task, and prepare a task for my review without sending replies.

output_examples.output: Three open conversations need an owner. They concern a billing question, a login issue, and a renewal request.

output_examples.input: Give the Acme email to Anna.
output_examples.output: The Acme billing conversation is ready to assign to Anna. The assignment is pending your confirmation.

output: Two of your conversations have completed replies.
They are ready to mark completed after you confirm.

best_practices: Name the mailbox and time window when searching for conversations.
Read the full thread before preparing or sending a customer reply.
Confirm the exact task list before making multiple assignments or closures.
anti_patterns: Do not send a reply without showing the text and receiving clear confirmation.
Do not assume missing tasks mean missing email access or missing group membership.
Do not close multiple tasks when the requested scope is unclear.

faq.question: What can this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages shared mailbox conversations and their related tasks, including triage, ownership, replies, and completion.

faq.question: Can it show unassigned conversations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can find open tasks without an owner and identify conversations that have no task yet.

faq.question: Can it read complete email threads?
faq.answer: Yes, when the connected account has access to the selected mailbox.

faq.question: Can it send replies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can reply in the same thread after showing the message and receiving clear confirmation.

faq.question: Why might a task or message be invisible?
faq.answer: Reading mail requires mailbox access, while viewing tasks requires membership in the mailbox group.

faq.question: Can it process many tasks at once?
faq.answer: It can prepare bulk changes, but it requires confirmation before assigning or closing many tasks.
